title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 1-5 years (¥700bn announced) — the print that scores the coupon-ordering question two months before the November slot
source: EST: mof.go.jp English September 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2609e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,797 bytes) — its table row reads 'Sep. 10, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 1-5 years)'. UNLIKE THE NOVEMBER SLOT, THIS ONE'S TERMS ARE ALREADY PUBLISHED: MOF's own announcement page announcement/auct20260903e.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 18,562 bytes), is dated September 3, 2026 and reads 'Offering Amount | About 700 billion yen', with eligible issues '2-year No.476-488, 5-year No.154-185, 10-year No.348-363, 20-year No.97-129, 30-year No.1-5'. Filed `estimate` regardless, on the two counts this lane records for every JGB entry: the reopened-issue list does not exist until MOF's 'Issues Re-opened' page publishes on the day, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED because it is the scoring instrument, not calendar padding. It is the immediately preceding print in the same 1-5y zone as its proposer, the last one before 2026-11-20, and MOF has already published its size and its exact eligible-issue list — so the ordering prediction the proposer registers can be scored against it on the day rather than waiting seventy-two days. On that published menu the eligible stock is ¥321.15tn: 2-Year ¥34.39tn (10.71%, 1.229% weighted-average coupon), 5-Year ¥114.59tn (35.68%, 0.720%), 10-Year ¥120.73tn (37.59%, 0.100%), 20-Year ¥49.95tn (15.55%, 2.055%) and 30-Year ¥1.50tn (0.47%, 2.507%) — computed this session from MOF's own Auction Results for JGBs workbook (past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13). A strict monotone-in-coupon reading, which the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22 ledger proposed as this zone's untested prediction, ranks the expected overweight 30Y > 20Y > 2Y > 5Y > 10Y. Sixteen prints of this zone's own record say it will not come out that way: 10-Year has beaten 5-Year at matched remaining maturity in 12 of 16 auctions despite carrying a lower coupon, and 30-Year has taken ¥16.5bn in total across 8 auctions. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. It shares its date with treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10, ppi-2026-09-10, ecb-decision-2026-09-10 and treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-09-10. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
